# Theory

Some references relevant to the algorithms in $\mathtt{deep\_tensor}$ are collected below.

## DIRT Algorithm

  - DIRT algorithm: @Cui2022
  - TT-IRT (single-layer DIRT) algorithm: @Dolgov2020

## Functional Tensor Trains

  - Functional tensor trains: @Bigoni2016, @Gorodetsky2019
  - Extended functional tensor trains: @Strossner2024
  - Tensor train decomposition: @Oseledets2011
  - TT cross-approximation algorithm: @Oseledets2010
  - Maxvol algorithm: @Goreinov2010

## Applications and Extensions of the DIRT Algorithm

  - State and parameter estimation: @Zhao2024
  - Optimal experimental design: @Koval2024
  - Rare event estimation: @Cui2024
  - Conditional simulation (amortised inference): @Cui2023
